confidence_notes: October 2026 Numbeo Marmaris food prices are based on only 136 entries from 9 contributors, and Turkish-lira prices need approximate USD normalization. Cocktail and wine anchors are estimated at about 2.4x and 1.7x the local draft-beer anchor because direct current city prices were unavailable. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates with substantial seasonal and property variation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Marmaris's position as a seasonal Aegean/Mediterranean resort town in Turkey; accommodation estimates are broad regional judgments rather than live listing prices.
